# CalcBox US
> Free US health and finance calculator tools with daily news.

## Site Info
- URL: https://thecalcbox.github.io/US/
- Language: English (American)
- Audience: United States users

## Tools Available

### Health Calculators
- BMI Calculator: Imperial units (lbs, ft/in). CDC adult categories. Healthy range: 18.5–24.9
- TDEE / Calorie Calculator: Mifflin-St Jeor formula. Weight loss & muscle gain targets
- Daily Water Intake: Based on body weight (lbs), exercise, and climate (oz/day)
- Sleep Calculator: CDC sleep recommendations by age. 90-minute cycle bedtime calculator
- Age Calculator: Exact age in years/months/days. Zodiac sign. Birthday countdown

### Finance Calculators
- Mortgage Calculator: US home loan calculator. 15 or 30-year fixed. Amortization schedule
- 401(k) Retirement Calculator: Employer match, 7% return assumption, balance at retirement
- Federal Income Tax Calculator: 2024 IRS brackets. All filing statuses. Standard deduction

### Daily News
- Health News: CDC Health (English)
- Finance News: MarketWatch (English)

## Data Sources
- BMI: CDC adult BMI standards
- Tax: 2024 IRS tax brackets and standard deductions
- 401k: IRS 2024 contribution limits ($23,000 / $30,500 catch-up)
- Mortgage: Standard amortization formula
- All results for informational purposes only. Not medical or financial advice.

## Taiwan Version
- URL: https://thecalcbox.github.io/
